title: The Parable of the Two Sons
description: Jesus asks the chief priests and the elders of the people: A man had two sons. He went to the first and said, "Go and work in the vineyard today." "I don't want to," he answered, but later changed his mind and went. The father went to the second son and said the same thing. He replied, "I will, sir," but did not go. Which of the two did the will of his father? "The first," they answered. Jesus said to them: "Truly I tell you, the tax collectors and the prostitutes are entering the kingdom of God ahead of you. For John came to you in the way of righteousness, and you did not believe him, but the tax collectors and the prostitutes did believe him."

versions.title: The Parable of the Two Sons
versions.description: Jesus asks the chief priests and the elders of the people: A man had two sons. He went to the first and said, 'Go and work in the vineyard today.' 'I will not,' he answered, but later he changed his mind and went. Then the father went to the other son and said the same thing. 'I will, sir,' he said, but he did not go. Which of the two did what his father wanted? 'The first,' they answered. Jesus said to them, 'Truly I tell you, the tax collectors and the prostitutes are entering the kingdom of God ahead of you. For John came to you to show you the way of righteousness, and you did not believe him, but the tax collectors and the prostitutes believed him.'
